description:
Images for video segments. check: mechanically check one public image URL (no LLM, relevance is for you to judge): returns one code (ok, blocked_403 when the host blocks the download — then use upload with bytes fetched on your own machine — and the size, type and aspect failures). upload: a local image becomes a mediaId for a segment (a temporary asset, 1 hour: upload shortly before generating).
Actions and their required fields: upload (path); check (url).

action.description: What to do: upload | check. The description lists the fields each action needs.

path.description: Local image file path (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 8MB — the engine photo limit, not the 10MB library limit).

url.description: Public image URL to check mechanically (no LLM, no relevance judgement).

videoAspect.description: Video aspect the image will fill (9:16 Shorts/Instagram, 16:9 long YouTube, 1:1 square). When given, an image that cannot fill the frame returns wrong_aspect instead of ok — send one that matches the aspect.

name: media
